title: Vocello generation request
description: One take as an agent asks for it (vocello run --request, one line of --requests, and the MCP server's generate_speech input). Each field is the generate option of the same name; the CLI parses the result as strictly as its command line.

variant.description: The model package; absent, the one the Mac app uses for the mode.

text.description: The script; never "-" (stdin carries the requests).

speaker.description: custom: a Built-in Voice speaker id.

voice.description: clone: a saved voice name or id.

reference.description: clone: a reference clip instead of a saved voice.

deliveryCell.description: custom: a preset cell such as calm.normal.

language.description: auto, a language name or a code such as fr.

seed.description: A deterministic sampling seed, preferably as a decimal string.

longForm.description: auto (default): a script past one take runs as a long-form project, as the apps route it; always: any script does; never: one past a take is refused.

confirmConsent.description: Required true to clone: you own or have permission to clone this voice.

appDelivery.description: With no delivery given, send the app's default delivery.

clientRequestID.description: Idempotency: the same id and request replays the stored result.
